# Abdulrahman Ambooka Msah — Portfolio Context

## Professional identity

Abdulrahman Ambooka Msah is a Computer Science graduate and software engineer based in Nairobi, Kenya. His work combines full-stack and backend software delivery with production payment integrations, ERP implementation, IT infrastructure administration, and applied computer vision. He is currently an IT Administrator at Bayina Academy.

## Headline

Software Engineer | Backend, Payments & IT Infrastructure

## Verified highlights

- Built full-stack web applications, REST APIs, and payment integrations for real clients.
- Built a production Node.js and TypeScript M-Pesa integration processing KES 1M+/month.
- Implemented ERPNext and replaced manual inventory, finance, procurement, and HR workflows.
- Administered Windows Server, Active Directory, networking, VoIP, CCTV, biometric systems, and end-user support.
- Configured 40+ workstations and helped resolve a DHCP conflict affecting 200+ campus devices.
- Built a computer-vision surveillance research system using YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and Flask.
